about_the_game:
WHAT IS UAZO ?

In Uazo, you play as a bird exploring procedurally-generated worlds filled with ancient ruins, magic artefacts and forgotten secrets. Play solo, or with your friends. Explore, gather resources, build nests and bird-houses, survive and uncover the story of this cloud shrouded island !

FLY FREELY

Uazo lets you play as a bird with near infinite flight, but it doesn't mean you can fly recklessly ! Flapping your wings consumes stamina, consuming stamina makes your bird hungry, and if you're hungry, you can't fly for long. So glide to take a breath, dive and use magic ! Be efficient so you can fly as long as you want !

EXPLORE STRANGE WORLDS

Explore a forgotten island surrounded by strange rotating ruins. Find traces of lost magic and open gates to other fantastic worlds. Search for clues from the sky and discover the history of the island. But beware, not everything is safe on this seemingly peaceful world !

BUILD YOURSELF A HOUSE

Use the resources you find around the island to build a bird-house on a tree, and have a cozy refuge to rest after your explorations, or as an outpost in the far reaches of the world. Customize both the outside and the inside of your house with a comfy nest, flowers, pillows and more !

CRAFT ITEMS TO HELP IN YOUR JOURNEY

Resources can also be used to craft a variety of items ! Food, tools, gear, but also magic items that will allow you to unlock the secrets hidden all over the world. Make use of everything you can find on your journey across the island of Uazo !

PLAY WITH YOUR FRIENDS

Don't want to play alone ? Don't worry, your friends can join you on your adventure with online co-op ! Play the way you want, explore at your own pace, and spend time with your fellow birds in a shared a home !

Key features:

  • Fly : You're a bird, flap your wings and soar through the sky !

  • Dive : Fly down at high speeds and use the momentum to travel long distances !

  • Explore : Fly through large procedurally-generated worlds with peaceful views !

  • Search : Look for clues on the ground from the sky to discover the secrets of the island !

  • Craft : Gather resources and craft items and equipment to help you on your journey !

  • Build : Make yourself a home in the trees to rest after a long day !

  • Farm : Grow plants, catch fish and cook to keep your stomach full and your wings strong !

  • Customize your bird ! Change the colors and shape of your feathers, or craft hats to wear !

  • Multiplayer : Explore solo or with friends in online co-op !

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: 2.6 GHz Quad Core or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 950 or Radeon HD 7970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: i5 3GHz or Ryzen 5 3GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Soar as a curious bird on a mysterious island filled with secrets, ancient ruins, and hidden wonders. Explore with your friends, gather resources, build, survive and uncover the island’s story in this serene adventure.
supported_languages: English, French, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Russian
